name: msgctl
synopsis: int msgctl(int msqid, int op, struct msqid_ds *buf);
description: msgctl() performs the control operation specified by op on the System V message queue identified by msqid. It can retrieve or set attributes of the message queue using a msqid_ds structure.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: Operation to perform, such as IPC_STAT, IPC_SET, or IPC_RMID

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Pointer to a msqid_ds structure for data exchange, depending on the operation

return_value.success: Returns 0 for IPC_STAT, IPC_SET, and IPC_RMID; returns the index for IPC_INFO or MSG_INFO; returns the queue identifier for MSG_STAT or MSG_STAT_ANY
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: The operation requires read permission but the caller lacks it
The address pointed to by buf is not accessible for IPC_SET or IPC_STAT
Invalid value for op or msqid, or the index in msqid is unused for MSG_STAT
The caller lacks permission for IPC_SET or IPC_RMID, or attempts to increase msg_qbytes beyond limits without privileges

bugs: Various fields in the struct msqid_ds changed types between Linux versions (e.g., short to long from Linux 2.2 to 2.4), and some fields are Linux-specific extensions not in POSIX.
versions: POSIX.1-2001, SVr4; Linux 2.4 and later for certain features
